collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: A collection is a set of runs the team keeps up together, such as "TB2 models". When creating one you choose a scenario, which fixes the dimensions that may vary and the values of the others; afterwards only matching runs can join. You can also select a few runs in the run list, compare them first, then "Make a collection".
collections.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Click "Save snapshot" on a comparison or collection page.
collections.baseRun: Base run: fixed dimensions take its values, and it is the collection's first run
collections.fromNewRun: You can also make a collection from a filled-in form on the "New run" page, without having a run first.

snapshot.frozenHint: The numbers were frozen when saved and do not change when runs or logs are later deleted or expire; whether the raw evidence still opens is shown under each run name.
